provider: HKU Business School BEcon and BEcon&Fin Syllabuses 2025-26
note: The official 2025-26 syllabuses apply to candidates admitted in 2025-26 and thereafter, subject to approval. The BEcon Major in Economics requires 60 Core credits and 18 Economics disciplinary elective credits. The BEcon&Fin Major in Economics and Finance requires 72 Core credits, 12 Economics disciplinary elective credits and 12 Finance disciplinary elective credits. Both dated elective appendices are closed coded lists; ECON4294 and FINA4392 carry 12 credits. Up to four approved MEcon courses may replace Economics disciplinary electives, so that approval path remains outside the published coded pool. Language, Common Core, AI literacy and free-elective requirements are excluded because they contain open or placeholder course ranges. Courses are not necessarily offered every year.

supplements.programmeName: Bachelor of Economics/ Bachelor of Economics and Finance (Major in Economics)
supplements.ruleSummary: 78 major credits: 24 Faculty Core credits, 36 Disciplinary Core credits including the ECON4200 capstone, and 18 Economics disciplinary elective credits from the dated List A.
supplements.evidenceGap: The official syllabus is subject to approval and says courses are not necessarily offered every year. It permits up to four approved MEcon courses as third- or fourth-year Economics disciplinary electives; those open approval-based substitutions are not expanded. The MATH1009/MATH1013 sequencing and exemption rule remains a manual check.
